description: Search and rank language schools. Returns school_id, url, indicative from-price, and reviews. Prices are not a booking quote; call calculate_trip_price before quoting a total.

city.description: Single city slug filter. Prefer cities[] for multiple.

country.description: Country slug or name filter from get_school_filters.

course_type.description: Course type slug from get_school_filters (e.g. intensive, private).

language.description: Language slug filter from get_school_filters (e.g. spanish, english).

locale.description: Response language and site context. One of en, nl, da, sv.

query.description: Free-text search (school name, city, or keyword). Empty returns popular matches for the other filters.

name: search_language_schools

data.description: Meilisearch-style payload with hits[] (school_id, title, url, city, country, pricing hints).
